description: Sound-based. Hits all adjacent opponents and goes through Substitute. Power is 1.5× against a target that is poisoned or badly poisoned. Vine Riff's answer to Toxtricity's Overdrive.
Sound-based. Hits all adjacent opponents and goes through Substitute. 20% chance to paralyze each target.
Fires molten iron from its back. Its power and effect depend on Cataggron's current form. Other Pokémon that learn it through Mimic or Sketch use the Standard version.
The user slams its sludge-soaked shield into the target. Damage is calculated with the user's Sp. Def instead of its Sp. Atk. 30% chance to poison the target.
It sets the target's mind alight. A special move that calculates damage against the target's Defense instead of its Sp. Def, like Psyshock. 10% chance to burn.
It charges with its rings blazing, then cuts them dark at the moment of impact. The user restores HP equal to half the damage it deals.
Hurls its gems one after another. Hits 2–5 times in a row. Each hit has a 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
Bites with crystal-studded jaws. A biting move that makes contact. 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

A two-turn move. On the first turn the user throws back its cloak and draws its bow. On the second turn it fires a volley of shadowed arrow quills. High critical-hit ratio. If it knocks out the target, the user's Speed rises by 1 stage. A Power Herb skips the charge turn.
Lunges up from the sand and clamps down. A biting move that makes contact. It can hit Flying-type Pokémon and Pokémon with Levitate; they take neutral damage from it.
Splashes the target with charged water. 20% chance to paralyze the target.
Lashes the target with a current that arcs across the water. 30% chance to paralyze. Power is 1.5× in rain.
Dives from high above with its wings folded. Makes contact. 30% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
Slashes with charged wing claws. Makes contact and has a high critical-hit ratio. 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Snaps up from beneath the sand. A biting move that makes contact and traps the target for 4–5 turns, dealing 1/8 of its max HP at the end of each turn.
Vibrates its wings to make a droning hum. Sound-based, so it goes through Substitute. 20% chance to confuse the target.
Slashes the air into a spinning cyclone. Power is 1.5× while Tailwind is active on the user's side.
Flashes the eye patterns on its wings. 10% chance to make the target fall asleep. When Mega Alolan Flygon uses it, the chance rises to 30%.
A quick punch charged with rune light. A punching move with +1 priority.
Swings its fist like a battering ram. A punching move that makes contact. It breaks the target's Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil before dealing damage.
Sprays water full of sharp coral grit. 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
Fires a beam of light from its pearls. A pulse move. 20% chance to raise the user's Sp. Def by 1 stage.
Calls up a storm from the reef. After it hits, rain starts and lasts 3 turns, or 5 turns if the user holds a Damp Rock.
